open_ad_collection in crates/nmp-nip-ad/src/collection.rs — the NIP-AD delivery doorway, mirroring nmp-nip50's per-relay pinned-search doorway:
- Added nmp-read-session dep to nmp-nip-ad/Cargo.toml (concept → engine; no runtime edge).
- ad_collection_demands: one ReadDemand per relay { filter_json = resolution.filter → NIP-01 JSON, relay_pin: Some(relay), lifecycle: OneShot, scope: Global, replay: Structural }. Multi-result first-class — full filter kept, no limit, no single-pointer reduction.
- Reducer: dedupe by event id (first arrival wins), order created_at desc. Per-row render deferred to nmp_content::resolve_embed_projection (not reimplemented).
- Typed ADCL FlatBuffers snapshot: schema/ad_collection.fbs + checked-in generated bindings (flatc 25.12.19, matches workspace pin; check-flatbuffers-version-pins.sh passes), mirroring nip50's N50S.
- Ownership: claimed projection.nmp.nip-ad.collection family in ownership.rs (the doctrine-lint ownership audit required it).
- Empty relays = fail-open (empty snapshot + live handle, not an error). [...] 2. `open_ad_collection` in `nmp-nip-ad` (the PR #2947 crate, whose `AdResolution { filter: nostr::Filter, relays: Vec<String> }` at parse.rs:25 is the input): one `ReadDemand { filter_json, relay_pin: Some(relay), lifecycle: OneShot, scope: Global, replay: Structural }` per resolved relay, one dedupe-by-id/order-by-created_at reducer, one typed collection snapshot; per-row rendering dispatches by kind through the existing `resolve_embed_projection` embed pipeline (`nmp-native-runtime/src/embed_sidecar.rs:144`). Unblocks #2927 Layers B/C unchanged. Template: `nip50/search/session.rs`. If product later wants `golf.com/highlights` to live-update while open, it's the same demand with the flag flipped — no re-architecture.
